goal:
A reviewer asked me to double-check a value from Uchenna et al. (2024), "Measuring Phoneme Drift" (http://journal-of-cold-region-materials.example/articles/734b61-measuring-phoneme-drift).
What estimated capacity does Table 2 report for station B-04? Please give the value with its unit and tell me which source you used.

sections: Abstract

We report estimated capacity measurements from five monitoring stations collected between 2022 and 2024. A pilot survey in 2019 had put the regional estimated capacity at 1.8 bits/param; we find marked differences between upland and coastal sites.
1. Introduction
Earlier studies of phoneme drift relied on single-site records [1, 2]. A multi-site campaign makes it possible to separate local effects from regional trends [3].
2. Methods

Station metadata are listed in Table 1. Measurements follow the protocol of [3]. Values from the 2021 campaign are given in Table 3 for comparison and are not directly comparable with the 2024 campaign because the instruments changed.
3. Results
Table 2 reports the estimated capacity for each station in the 2024 campaign. The largest change relative to 2021 was observed at station T-22.
4. Discussion
The spread between stations exceeds the measurement uncertainty, which suggests that site conditions dominate. Longer records are needed to confirm the trend.
References
[1] Kaczmarek et al. (2018). [2] Oyelaran and Ferreira (2020). [3] Ilunga et al. (2021).
